name: Miko Miko Life ~Ponkotsu Osananajimi to Honobono Inaka Seikatsu~
original_name: みこみこライフ～ぽんこつ幼なじみとほのぼの田舎性活～
source:
You were spending your summer vacation lazily at home. Then, your mother came up to you and said:

“You’re free during summer break, right? Go help out at Minori-chan’s place.”

Though reluctant, you head to the countryside shrine where your childhood friend lives.
After a long bus ride, feeling a mix of excitement and nervousness about seeing your childhood friend again for the first time in a while, you finally arrive only to find the shrine in a shockingly run-down state...
translation:
你在家里慵懒地度过了暑假。然后，你妈妈走过来对你说：

“暑假你有空吧？去小实里那里帮忙吧。”

尽管不情愿，你还是前往了你儿时好友居住的乡村神社。
乘坐长途巴士后，你对时隔一段时间再次见到儿时好友感到既兴奋又紧张，终于到达神社，却发现神社破败得令人震惊……
